items.title: The Canal Zone's boundary lines and the Ancon's passage of 15 August 1914 (drawn map)
items.content_basis: the Zone's two boundary lines and the places as the Isthmian Canal Commission's sheet of 1 July 1909 draws them, read against its printed graticule; the line joins the places of the Ancon's passage of 15 August 1914 in their order (Canal Record VII no. 52, p. 521; F42), straight between them, never a course. Coast and land from Natural Earth. The boundary around the cities of Colon and Panama, outside the Zone, is not drawn; the west line is drawn from offshore, as the sheet draws it, to its last milepost at the Pacific shore, the east line to its last milepost (100) north of Panama.
